source_instruction: find a mattress with high density foam with cover included.
query: Man, I swear the commute home today was so much worse than usual—there was a whole group of baby geese waddling slow as molasses right across the main crosswalk by the park, and every single car stopped to let them meander, even the guy who usually honks at anyone going five under the speed limit. I ended up sitting there for almost ten minutes watching the parent geese herd the fuzzy little goslings up over the curb, and one tiny one kept tripping over its own feet trying to keep up, it was so cute I almost forgot I was supposed to rush home to walk my dog before he chews up another throw pillow. By the time I got parked, my neighbor was out front passing around homemade chocolate chip cookies she’d baked for the block, still warm and oozing melted chocolate, so I stood and chatted with her for a minute too, which made me run even later than I already was. Hey, I’m looking for a mattress from this section, right? I need one that’s medium density for sure, and I want that one that comes with the extra add-on I usually grab, and my budget cap is $260 total. Oh, and make sure it comes with a built-in USB charging port on the side too, that’s non-negotiable for me. I don’t want to go through a ton of options, just narrow it down to what fits what I’m asking for, yeah?
